diagnostics.message: The kubernetes_service_account_v1.irsa resource in module.adot_collector_haproxy.module.helm_addon.module.irsa is placed in the namespace named by var.kubernetes_namespace, but it has no dependency (attribute reference or depends_on) on the kubernetes_namespace_v1.irsa resource that creates that namespace in the same module. If both resources are created (create_kubernetes_namespace = true), Terraform may create the service account before the namespace exists, causing the apply to fail or the account to be orphaned in a pending namespace.
